<script lang="ts">
  import { Picker } from '@larose-ui/svelte';

  const columns = [
    {
      id: 'dept',
      label: 'Department',
      options: [
        { value: 'eng', label: 'Engineering' },
        { value: 'design', label: 'Design' },
        { value: 'sales', label: 'Sales' },
      ],
    },
  ];
